text: With the focus of the Clan, elder leaf bundles, horsetail clumps, marigold, ragwort, cobwebs, doses of poppy seeds, wild garlic, tansy, mullein, betony, plantain bundles, raspberry clusters, juniper bunches, catmint piles, moss clumps, thyme bundles, burdock roots, daisies, oak leaf bundles, goldenrod, and dandelions were gathered.

RiverClan and CougarClan arrive at the Gathering's meeting place at the same time; Yewstar halts the Clan with a tail-signal and gestures for CougarClan's leader to enter first. (CougarClan relations improved.)
No matter how much RiverClan searches, they can't find a hair on Pigment's pelt.
Yewstar runs to greet Flightsplash when he returns from a patrol. (medium positive effect)
Yewstar says Quailfur sets a bad example of a warrior. (medium negative effect)
Prancelaurel and Poppykit share their prey with one another every day. (high positive effect)
Prancelaurel is fascinated by one of Peatcrest's stories. (medium positive effect)
Craneflight finally feels back to normal after the strain of birthing a litter.
Craneflight reassures Diablofoot about something that was bothering her. (low positive effect)
When Craneflight gets hurt, Erminedaisy is the first to ask if she's okay. (medium positive effect)
Primfreckle has recovered from whitecough.
Craneflight motivated Primfreckle to get out of her nest this morning. (low positive effect)
Primfreckle wants, more than anything, to confess her love to Auburnsplash. (medium positive effect)
Peatcrest prevents something from falling on Gorgekit. (low positive effect)
Peatcrest sees Algaepool put something back where it belongs. (low positive effect)
Peatcrest has a running nose.
Carptail and Fringesnap debated something interesting for hours yesterday. (high positive effect)
Peatcrest respects Carptail's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Brinerump uses one of Saffronfoot's fears against him. (high negative effect)
The moon casts a shadow on Stoatshade's face in a way that makes Saffronfoot uneasy. (medium negative effect)
Saffronfoot and Suntooth have been sickeningly lovey-dovey all day. (high positive effect)
When Cobaltstrike comes to Oddmuzzle with pain, Oddmuzzle tells him to suck it up. (medium negative effect)
Oddmuzzle is deeply touched hearing just how much Peakspore remembers about him. (high positive effect)
Hollyheart tells Fidgetmouse to count on him in a difficult situation. (high positive effect)
Hollyheart was flattered by Icyriver's politeness this morning. (low positive effect)
Heavythud settles near Carptail to eat his fresh-kill. (medium positive effect)
Heavythud, Bitterleaf, and Poolleaf took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
The silence between Heavythud and Voletuft feels more uncomfortable than usual. (low negative effect)
Heavythud thinks Oddmuzzle has a lovely sense of humor. (medium positive effect)
Pearpelt tells Flutterfeather that they was worried about him. (low positive effect)
Flutterfeather keeps complaining about something Dancingfleck did. (medium negative effect)
Saltknoll watched Carptail show kindness and compassion towards his patients. (medium positive effect)
The Clan is surprised to see Saltknoll and Sardinespeckle chatting casually over a meal. (medium positive effect)
Curryfoot is deeply touched hearing just how much Blizzardstripe remembers about her. (high positive effect)
Petalglow keeps asking Curryfoot if she trusts her. (low negative effect)
Tomatofreckle overhears a Clanmate praise Verbenabloom for something Tomatofreckle actually did. (low negative effect)
Erminedaisy gives Tomatofreckle something that she dropped. (low positive effect)
Kamautail saw Wavepaw being considerate. (low positive effect)
Kamautail tells Heatherfern, Craneflight, Fringesnap, and Stoatshade a story that earns more skepticism than admiration. (negative effect)
Mosscrackle mentions that Kamautail looks good today. (low positive effect)
Stoatshade sighs at the mere mention of Molekit. (high negative effect)
Stoatshade thinks he can tell Fidgetmouse something important. (high positive effect)
Ochretail can tell how brave Blotchpaw is being about something important. (low positive effect)
Ochretail heard Mallardfeather say something mean. (low negative effect)
Ochretail pulls Algaepool to the side, quietly asking him about his crush on a fellow Clanmate.
Algaepool lied to Verbenabloom's face. (high negative effect)
Algaepool is talking with Reedheart. (low positive effect)
Bouncepelt doesn't respect Auburnsplash's personal space lately. (high negative effect)
Auburnsplash might be reading a little too far into Blizzardstripe's kindness. (low positive effect)
Lightpelt announced that she is expecting kits. She couldn't settle into the nursery fast enough.
Only Lightpelt and Reedheart know the details about a specific piece of Clan drama. (medium positive effect)
Lightpelt got tricked into doing one of Warmswirl's chores. (low negative effect)
Poolleaf squashes a bug that Warmswirl was watching. (medium negative effect)
Fringesnap accuses Warmswirl of lying about something Warmswirl has no reason to lie about. (medium negative effect)
Amberfur and Heatherfern debate about something interesting. They end up agreeing. (medium positive effect)
Amberfur tells Fluttershade, Gracklefur, Shadowpaw, and Snookpaw a story that earns more skepticism than admiration. (negative effect)
Amberfur sees a glimmer of determination in Pestofoot's eyes. (low positive effect)
Fringesnap thinks he can tell Verbenabloom something important. (high positive effect)
The Clan feels uneasy whenever Fringesnap and Icyriver speak to each other. (high negative effect)
Blotchpaw is amazed at how skilled Brindletooth really is. (high positive effect)
Blotchpaw just told Wavepaw a hilarious joke. (medium positive effect)
Blotchpaw was seen playing with a kittypet over the border. The Clan has encountered Hubert.
Pebblechase thanks Peakspore for covering for him during a patrol earlier. (medium positive effect)
When Peatcrest gets sick for a few days, Pebblechase brings him fresh-kill and bedding. (high positive effect)
Heatherfern has healed from the strain of delivering her litter.
Heatherfern can't imagine her life if she never met Erminedaisy. (high positive effect)
Heatherfern tried to explain something to Bitterleaf, but he just didn't understand. (low negative effect)
Fidgetmouse warns Icyriver about something on the ground so she doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
Fidgetmouse is annoyed Heatherfern paid more attention to Harefeather than she did to her recently. (negative effect)
Fidgetmouse sees that Bushberry's piece of prey looks tastier and asks if he'd like to swap. He agrees happily, saying he likes that one better. (low positive effect)
Archbellow can't believe how talented Midnightkit is! (high positive effect)
Archbellow wants to spend the entire day with Saffronfoot. (high positive effect)
Nightglow's bite-wound has healed.
Nightglow appreciates Lightpelt telling him that he had a feather stuck to his face. (low positive effect)
Nightglow promises to always look out for Suntooth. (high positive effect)
Nightglow was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Paellapad last night... (high positive effect)
Cobaltstrike can think of a hundred good things to say about Curryfoot. (high positive effect)
Cobaltstrike and Oddmuzzle find out they're both bringing flowers to the same Clanmate's grave. (high positive effect)
Mallardfeather has healed from the strain of delivering her litter.
Mallardfeather wakes up Bushberry every morning so they're up together. (high positive effect)
Mallardfeather and Peatcrest drink from the same puddle. (low positive effect)
Pigeonbloom picks themself up out of their nest and begins the day anew, a fresh conviction in their heart.
Pigeonbloom feels bad that they caused a problem for Swallowkit. (medium positive effect)
Quailfur told Pigeonbloom something awful, and Pigeonbloom may never look at him quite the same. (high negative effect)
Blizzardstripe has a friendly chat with Wasppaw that leaves them both feeling happy. (low positive effect)
Blizzardstripe sees that Lightpelt's piece of prey looks tastier and asks if she'd like to swap. She agrees happily, saying she likes that one better. (low positive effect)
Bitterleaf's bruises are gone.
Bitterleaf thinks that Antlerthorn spread a rumor about him. (medium negative effect)
Bitterleaf sees Bouncepelt help a Clanmate get unstuck from some brambles. (low positive effect)
Bitterleaf is sick with whitecough.
Harefeather and Erminedaisy volunteer to go on an extra border patrol together. (medium positive effect)
Harefeather learns something new about a Clanmate from Saffronfoot. (low positive effect)
Paellapad's broken bone has healed.
Paellapad made an extremely hurtful remark about one of Dancingscreech's friends just to spite Dancingscreech. (high negative effect)
Paellapad worries about how capable Cobaltstrike is. (medium negative effect)
Paellapad saved Bitebone from a dog, and was barely even hurt! She's a bit bruised, but bruises are better than clawmarks.
Skiphare believes in Dancingscreech's version of events when something happens and the Clan doubts her. (high positive effect)
Peakspore is the only one who gets Dancingscreech's joke. (medium positive effect)
Fluttershade has noticed Bushberry isn't doing a lot of work lately. (medium negative effect)
Fluttershade eats as ravenously as a wolverine and by the time she's done, Harefeather, Bitterleaf, and Reedheart barely have the stomach to finish their own meals. (negative effect)
Bitebone makes a small sacrifice that benefits Fluttershade. (low positive effect)
Dahliacrest tries to convince Gracklefur that an obvious lie is real. (medium negative effect)
Gracklefur notices that Archbellow brought him a big piece of prey. (medium positive effect)
Peakspore wishes that a Clanmate liked him as much as they like Rosekit. (medium negative effect)
Peakspore confesses to Dancingscreech that he has feelings for Peatcrest. (positive effect)
Fluttershade gave Peakspore a gift that doesn't make sense. (medium negative effect)
Bitebone listens to Antlerthorn's big plans for the day. (low positive effect)
Bitebone brings Warmswirl some fresh-kill, hoping that he remembered what Warmswirl's favorite was. (high positive effect)
Bitebone can't stop gushing over Quailfur. (high positive effect)
Bouncepelt's claw-wound has healed, but he'll always carry evidence of it on his pelt.
Bitterleaf is upset after spending the day with Bouncepelt's bad attitude. (low negative effect)
Bouncepelt and Reedheart perk up happily when they see each other. (medium positive effect)
Burrweb died from water in his lungs.
Suntooth can't help but smile when around Snippool. (low positive effect)
Suntooth had a dream about Brinerump. (low positive effect)
Pigeonbloom mentions that Pearpelt looks good today. (low positive effect)
Pearpelt caught Saffronfoot complaining about them behind their back. (medium negative effect)
Pearpelt's tail was badly injured by a dog.
Quailfur and Skiphare argue about religion in the middle of camp. (high negative effect)
Quailfur won't keep his mouth shut during the Gathering. Pebblechase, Freezefoot, and Archbellow can barely hear the leader's announcements! (negative effect)
Diablofoot can't stop thinking about the strange joke Erminedaisy told the other day. (medium negative effect)
Diablofoot admits she really admires Snippool's recent efforts. (medium positive effect)
Reedheart's whitecough is gone.
Reedheart had a dream about Icyriver. (low positive effect)
Brinerump can tell Suntooth worries about his health and safety. (high positive effect)
Brinerump asks Freezefoot about a lie Freezefoot told, but she dodges the question. (medium negative effect)
Dahliacrest trusts Fluttershade with a very important task. (high positive effect)
Dahliacrest, Warmswirl, and Fluttershade took a sunbath and had a little small talk. (positive effect)
Dahliacrest's hackles raise when Oddmuzzle passes by. (medium negative effect)
Freezefoot healed from her mangled tail but will forever be marked by a scar.
Wasppaw laughs a little too long at one of Freezefoot's jokes. (low negative effect)
Freezefoot thinks that Fringesnap's tone sounds off today. (low negative effect)
Voletuft accidentally hurts Snippool during an argument between them. (high negative effect)
Warmswirl gives Snippool something that she dropped. (low positive effect)
Snippool watches Murkhaven give an elder the best piece of prey on the pile. She feels lucky to have such a kind cat as her mate.
Gardeniaglow loses in a race against Snakedrop and acts bitterly about it. (low negative effect)
Gardeniaglow comes up with a plan to sneak out of camp with Fleadusk. (medium positive effect)
Mossflight and Pearpelt always have something to share with each other. (high positive effect)
Mossflight can barely keep up with Shardtail. (medium positive effect)
Tomatofreckle says that Hushshimmer smells weird. (medium negative effect)
Hushshimmer wonders why Poolleaf is so pouty today. (low negative effect)
Yewstar calls out the Clan for targeting Shardtail. (high positive effect)
Shardtail and Kiwifoot find a hidden part of the territory and keep it a secret together. (medium positive effect)
Kiwifoot appreciates how Suntooth always seems to ask how she's doing. (high positive effect)
During a patrol, Kiwifoot and Mossflight have a long conversation about their beliefs and agree on many things. (medium positive effect)
While on a patrol, Verbenabloom secretly pulled back a branch and made it whop Cherrypaw in the face. (medium negative effect)
Verbenabloom struggles to make sense of something trivial Hollyheart said. (low negative effect)
Fleadusk is wowed by how bravely Archbellow fought the other day. (high positive effect)
Fleadusk tracked a trail of muddy pawprints into the warrior's den, straight through the nests of Antlerthorn and Quailfur. (negative effect)
Fleadusk doesn't tell Voletuft that they forgot to groom a part of their fur. (low negative effect)
Skulkwillow doesn't think Sardinespeckle's weird joke was just a joke. (medium negative effect)
Saltknoll vents about something trivial to Skulkwillow. (low positive effect)
Skulkwillow has a running nose.
When tucking in for the night, Murkhaven saw that Pebblechase fixed their nest. (low positive effect)
Murkhaven thinks Icyriver is a very good listener. (low positive effect)
Icyriver bristles after being scolded by Shiveringkit. (high negative effect)
The silence between Icyriver and Kiwifoot feels more uncomfortable than usual. (low negative effect)
Fleadusk's advice is more helpful than Elmtrail expected. (medium positive effect)
Spittle and flecks of bone fly while Elmtrail gobbles down prey, reminding Murkhaven, Icyriver, Skulkwillow, and Shinefur to seek out better mealtime companionship next time. (negative effect)
Mallowpelt gently woke up Elmtrail this morning. (medium positive effect)
Brindletooth and Freezefoot defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Brindletooth is admiring Mossflight from afar... (low positive effect)
Brindletooth was caught enjoying a moonlit stroll with Skulkwillow last night... (high positive effect)
Heavythud brought Sardinespeckle some dry bedding. (low positive effect)
Sardinespeckle includes Verbenabloom in a conversation that Verbenabloom struggled to join. (low positive effect)
Shinefur can walk and move without pain — her sprain must have healed.
Shinefur learns some pelt-grooming techniques from Shardtail, and tells Shardtail some of her own. (low positive effect)
Shinefur and Poolleaf nearly got in a bloody fight if it weren't for the intervention of a Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Shinefur and Elmtrail are so cuddled up and cozy in their nest they almost miss the dawn patrol.
The Clan can't believe the things Talonlake and Shardtail say to one another. (high negative effect)
Talonlake and Flightsplash mark the same spot of the border as a sign of friendship. Gross. (medium positive effect)
Talonlake sneaks out at night to sleep in Onemuzzle's nest. (high positive effect)
Frondpad thanks Archbellow for covering for her during a patrol earlier. (medium positive effect)
After Kiwifoot says something seemingly innocent, Frondpad sulks for the rest of the day. (high negative effect)
For a moment, Poolleaf thought Kiwifoot sounded like someone else. (medium negative effect)
Poolleaf, Verbenabloom, and Bitebone had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Pheasantbrush appreciates Kiwifoot's helpful attitude. (low positive effect)
Pheasantbrush hopes she just misheard Hailfreckle's rude remark. (low negative effect)
A Clanmate claims that Mallowpelt and Suntooth were sharing tongues. (high positive effect)
Fringesnap says something in passing that Mallowpelt keeps getting worked up about. (low negative effect)
Onemuzzle laughed at Talonlake for making a mistake on a patrol. (medium negative effect)
Onemuzzle's eagerness to do early morning stretches rubs off on Pestofoot, Mosscrackle, Yewstar, and Suntooth. (positive effect)
Onemuzzle and Frondpad defended their Clan at the Gathering together. (high positive effect)
Some things have been rough for Bitebone lately, but Pestofoot admires his willingness to go on. (medium positive effect)
Pestofoot stiffens up a little whenever someone mentions Voletuft. (medium negative effect)
Voletuft won't take Ospreykit seriously. (medium negative effect)
Voletuft badly misinterprets Sardinespeckle's words. (high negative effect)
Saffronfoot snickered when Flightsplash tripped. (low negative effect)
Flightsplash feels comfortable challenging Pestofoot on something she said. (high positive effect)
Skiphare wasn't going to help a Clanmate, but realized that Gardeniaglow would do it in a heartbeat. (medium positive effect)
For a moment, Skiphare thought Flightsplash sounded like someone else. (medium negative effect)
Hailfreckle spent a long time talking with Hollyheart and was impressed by Hollyheart's insight. (high positive effect)
Pheasantbrush was supposed to be showing Hailfreckle a cool battle move but messed up so badly it made Hailfreckle cringe. (medium negative effect)
Hailfreckle has a stomachache.
Shimmerrunner is looking out for Shiveringkit's well-being. (medium positive effect)
Shimmerrunner and Mallowpelt nearly got in a bloody fight if it weren't for the intervention of a Clanmate. (high negative effect)
Rollshock wants Dancingfleck to understand how crazy he is about him. (medium positive effect)
Rollshock knows that Flutterfeather would be saved before him during an emergency. (high negative effect)
Rollshock and Pheasantbrush got so into playing around that they got separated from the rest of the patrol, earning themselves an earful back at camp. (medium positive effect)
An outsider places their scent near the border, a polite courtesy that indicates they don't mean trouble. The Clan has encountered French.
Dancingfleck's tick fever has subsided.
Dancingfleck sees a pretty flower in Gentleghost's nest. (low positive effect)
Dancingfleck keeps asking Shimmerrunner to explain a joke, but Shimmerrunner just says that Dancingfleck had to be there. (low negative effect)
Nightglow respects Snakedrop's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Gentleghost helps Snakedrop hide from a Clanmate. (low positive effect)
Daisymoor saw Molekit being considerate. (low positive effect)
Flightsplash learns that Daisymoor told a Clanmate one of his secrets. (low negative effect)
Daisymoor has gotten whitecough.
Gentleghost thinks that Carnationkit will grow up to be an excellent member of the Clan. (medium positive effect)
Dancingfleck helps Gentleghost pick burrs out of his fur. (medium positive effect)
Gentleghost picks cattails near Gathering Island and decides to wear them.
Mallardfeather makes a small sacrifice that benefits Antlerthorn. (low positive effect)
Antlerthorn turned to Gentleghost in a time of need, only for Gentleghost to abandon him. (high negative effect)
Wasppaw escorted Saffronfoot so he could gather herbs. (medium positive effect)
Wasppaw spends the day helping around the camp with Shadowpaw. (high positive effect)
Snookpaw no longer has a running nose.
Snookpaw had a funny dream about Fringesnap and can't take him seriously now. (low negative effect)
Snookpaw can't believe how talented Wavepaw is! (high positive effect)
Shadowpaw laughed at Kiwifoot for making a mistake on a patrol. (medium negative effect)
Shadowpaw's friend doesn't trust Wavepaw. (low negative effect)
Wavepaw is awed by how much Petalglow has done for the Clan. (low positive effect)
Cherrypaw snickered when Wavepaw tripped. (low negative effect)
Gardeniaglow's laugh reminds Cherrypaw of someone she misses. (low positive effect)
A strong Clan stands on their own four paws, needing no support from others. VoleClan's new leader decides that the other Clans need reminding of this fact and withdraws their alliances at once.
Every muscle in Piperpaw's body tenses when Heavythud walks by. (high negative effect)
Drizzlekit does something that makes Piperpaw's day a little happier. (low positive effect)
Petalglow asks Pearpelt to look at a little cut on her leg. (high positive effect)
Petalglow keeps complaining about something Kamautail did. (medium negative effect)
Petalglow never realized how much she loves spending time with Craneflight. (low positive effect)
Mosscrackle saw Blizzardstripe show off a skill she never knew he had. (high positive effect)
Mosscrackle notices that Craneflight is always one of the first to volunteer for a difficult task. (medium positive effect)
Erminedaisy bestows wisdom onto Bushberry. (low positive effect)

Erminedaisy bestows wisdom onto Ochretail. (low positive effect)
During rough weather, Daisymoor helps Bushberry get safely to his den. (medium positive effect)
Mallardfeather saves the funniest jokes for Bushberry. (medium positive effect)
Drizzlepaw has reached the age of six moons and has been made an apprentice.
Drizzlepaw and Craneflight argue about religion in the middle of camp. (high negative effect)
Drizzlepaw noticed that Cherrypaw is falling behind in training and offered to help her catch up. (medium positive effect)
Newly-made apprentice Currentpaw touches noses with her new mentor, Pheasantbrush.
Currentpaw's friend says nice things about Craneflight, but it just makes Currentpaw jealous. (low negative effect)
Currentpaw doesn't tell Molekit that he forgot to groom a part of his fur. (low negative effect)
Gorgepaw has reached the age of six moons and has been made an apprentice.
Gorgepaw has to snap Yewstar out of a daze to ask a question. (low negative effect)
Tansykit keeps asking Gorgepaw if she trusts her. (low negative effect)
Tansykit thinks Dancingscreech was nice to her today. (low positive effect)
Tansykit appreciates Molekit telling her that she had a feather stuck to her face. (low positive effect)
Tansykit snuck out of camp and brought back some raspberry when her fur got snagged in a bush.
Silkykit gets excellent advice from Shadowpaw about something he had been worrying about. (high positive effect)
Silkykit complains about something Molekit did. (low negative effect)
Piperpaw sends a Clanmate to help Butterflykit with something he's struggling with. (low positive effect)
Butterflykit wants to show Carnationkit his favorite toy. (medium positive effect)
Erminedaisy does something that badly affects Molekit. (medium negative effect)
Bravekit laughs a little too long at one of Molekit's jokes. (low negative effect)
Glowkit defends Curryfoot in conversations. (high positive effect)
Glowkit is demanding Butterflykit's attention. (medium positive effect)
Whiskerkit dispels a bad rumor about Brinerump. (high positive effect)
Tansykit sides with a Clanmate instead of Whiskerkit on something. (medium negative effect)
Whiskerkit has gotten kittencough.
Paellapad didn't put a lot of thought into an answer for Swallowkit's question. (low negative effect)
Bravekit doesn't want to apologize to Swallowkit for something. (medium negative effect)
Carnationkit feels like Hailfreckle isn't taking his own personal health seriously. (medium negative effect)
Carnationkit, Blizzardstripe, and Yewstar had a nice talk while eating. (positive effect)
Carnationkit said something that rubbed Drizzlepaw the wrong way. (low negative effect)
Midnightkit warns Heatherfern about something on the ground so she doesn't trip. (low positive effect)
Bravekit explains what a joke means to Erminedaisy. (low positive effect)
Bravekit thinks about how lucky she is to have someone like Midnightkit as a friend. (high positive effect)

Ospreykit keeps avoiding eye contact with Shiveringkit. (medium negative effect)

Carptail learns that Heathkit told a Clanmate one of his secrets. (low negative effect)
Heathkit thinks the Clan's ancestors smile upon Shiveringkit. (high positive effect)
Rosekit doesn't think that Pheasantbrush's smile is genuine. (high negative effect)
Rosekit always goes to Heathkit first when he needs advice. (high positive effect)
Whiskerkit doesn't want to apologize to Poppykit for something. (medium negative effect)
Heathkit respects Poppykit's opinion despite disagreeing with it. (low positive effect)
Clawkit dreams about something that feels prophetic, and starts to act strange around Peatcrest. (high negative effect)
Clawkit woke up with a mild headache, but got up to play anyway, trying to ignore the nagging pain.
Bouncepelt skips eating a meal so Creekkit can have food. (medium positive effect)
Creekkit says Clawkit's name is stupid, but Creekkit is just jealous. (medium negative effect)
Meadowkit is talking with Shadowpaw. (low positive effect)
Meadowkit wants to be closer to Clawkit. (low positive effect)
Burrweb was such a source of solace and peace for Curryfoot that she wonders how she'll get by without him.
The world seems dim and lifeless without Burrweb, and Peakspore keeps close to his Clan, seeking out their comfort and company.
Quailfur is eager to get up and busy himself the next day. He refuses to sit and dwell on Burrweb's death, but finds he can only stare blankly at his paws.
Poppykit feels unsteady at the thought of trying to pad through life without Burrweb to rely on.

This past moon, m_c has taken {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} place in StarClan. c_n mourns the loss of their Clanmate, and {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates will miss where {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had been in their lives. Moments of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} life are shared in stories around the circle of mourners as those that were closest to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} take {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} final resting place.
